critical_issues.title: Literature basis is indexed, not verified
critical_issues.detail: All seven supplied documents remain external_report with no local PDF review, so no claim built on them can be cited yet.

guardrails: PASS is a caller retention label, not confirmed somatic truth.
Filtered is not equivalent to false positive.
High coverage in the source sample is not low-tumor-fraction sensitivity.
The parked direction stays parked: no claim about phase or methylation is made while it is.
research_goal: Can long-read ONT provide additional evidence that helps distinguish tumor-derived signal from biological and technical background?
current_stage_plain: Exploring which ONT evidence is actually useful before building a detector.
